text: A virtual tabletop for structured exercises for teaching ethics and practicing civil discourse skills. Exercises designed by the R&D Studio at the Edmond & Lily Safra Center for Ethics, Harvard University.
Open a room for one of the exercises below, send its link to your group, and start an activity once everyone has joined. If someone has given you a room code, join that room instead.

Open a room for this exercise and send its link to your group. Everyone shares the room’s table; start an activity from the room’s list when the group is ready, or run several tables at once as a class.
